name: NA-P50
description:
## Description

"Headphone stereo with tuner.FM/AM/TV (/ TV (1-12ch) synthesizer tuner, each of which can be pre-set to 5stations for a total of 15stations, allowing for one shot selection.* The TV receiving circuit of the NA-P50is also used as the FM receiving circuit, and the FM broadcasting may interfere when receiving 2or 3channels of audio.The remote control section allows switching, tuning and volume adjustment of the receiving band.Equipped with a heavy bass circuit CBBS (Casio Bus Boost System).Equipped with Dolby B NR as a noise reduction system.It supports quick charging, and it can play for about 1hour with 10minutes of charging.As for the Oatley berth function, you can choose between one round trip and endless.Equipped with a metal tape compatible tape selector.Equipped with a clock function that digitally displays the current time.Equipped with alarm function and 60-minute sleep timer."

name: NA-PW5
description:
